part.name: simple_plate
part.description: Synthetic E2E fixture: rectangular plate, one through hole, filleted vertical corners. Dimensions are test data, NOT derived from any photo.

reference.origin_definition: back-lower-left corner of the plate; +X to the right, +Y up, +Z out of the front face

measurements.name: overall_width
measurements.measurement_instruction: Max overall width across the plate with calipers.

measurements.name: overall_height
measurements.measurement_instruction: Max overall height of the plate with calipers.

measurements.name: thickness
measurements.measurement_instruction: Plate thickness with calipers, away from the fillets.

measurements.name: hole_dia
measurements.measurement_instruction: Inner diameter of the through hole with calipers.

measurements.name: hole_x_from_origin
measurements.measurement_instruction: Distance from the left edge to the hole centre.

measurements.name: hole_y_from_origin
measurements.measurement_instruction: Distance from the bottom edge to the hole centre.

measurements.name: corner_radius
measurements.measurement_instruction: Radius of the rounded vertical corners with a radius gauge.
